title: Imprint
intro: This is a stand-in. PartnerStandard Desk's hosted service at https://desk.partnerstandard.com shows its operator's own imprint, which its build adds from a private place. A server you run yourself shows none of these pages: it links to your own, set with `LEGAL_IMPRINT_URL` (deploy/.env.example).

sections.heading: Who operates this site
blocks: The operator's name, address and contact, as the law of their country asks.
